items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Well, all that you could have got from Peter Bocas. I don't see why they didn't give it. Maybe he mentioned it.

ctx.x: Well, all that you could have got from Peter Bocas. I don't see why they didn't give it. Maybe he mentioned it.
Peter Bocas could give you all those colors. We did interview him. He talked for quite a while. Then he told him. I forgot the name for him.
